content:
The **Poseidon Energy Plant Yard** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. It is a Public Workshop with claim and defend event quests.

The transformer yard in front of the power plant has been fitted with a Workshop.

This is one of the larger Workshops, located immediately next to the nuclear power plant. Apart from a Workshop station, it includes a Vertibot landing pad and the transformer enclosure. By the side entrance to the power plant is an electric box giving 400 electricity if the power plant is operating, and a Fusion Core Processor hooked up to it. Two more can be found with one by the Vertibot landing pad and another next to the Workshop to provide power to the resource extractors.

The available resources here are food (9), water (8), Fusion Cores (3), and Lead, Aluminum, nuclear, and Concrete (1 each). If claimed, the Vertibot landing pad will spawn a level 20 Vertibot which will automatically defend the transformer yard. The player character can also repair two Gun Emplacements along the southern road providing protection, and fortify them with additional Turrets to defend them from attacks. If the Vertibot is destroyed, usually from the lingering Scorched on the power plant's roof, the landing pad can be repaired again to spawn a fresh one.

The Poseidon Energy Plant Yard appears in *Fallout 76*.
